## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or maintainer-visible result and link its acceptance criteria.

## Risk and compatibility

Describe file-mutation, security, adapter, migration, or release effects. Use “none” only after checking.

## Verification

List exact commands and manual evidence. Note skipped or unavailable checks.

## Checklist

- [ ] Unrelated changes are preserved.
- [ ] User-visible behavior and compatibility evidence are documented.
- [ ] No secrets, debug artifacts, or unreviewed generated drift are included.
